Sanjay (Support): FYI flagging Greenline Labs — support saw repeat latency spikes on their Private deployment during yesterday's batch ingest. not resolved in first-touch, escalating to CS for priority comms.
Michelle (CS): @Sanjay can you summarize the impact & renewal timing? I want to draft the comms plan. :memo: 
Sanjay (Support): Impact: 95th p95 from 120ms -> 2.1s for streaming tokens, intermittent 503s when KV cache is invalidated. Affects nightly ingest and some API calls. Renewal in ~6 weeks, accounts team (Julia) reported they told customer they'd stabilize perf first.
Julia (AE): Confirmed — renewal conversation scheduled for 5/12. Customer has pilot-to-prod clause; unhappy if SLA hit continues.
Eli (SRE): Quick notes from logs: saw cache thrash after their bulk upsert job at 02:14 UTC. Worker pod OOMs on a few hosts; docker healthcheck restarts. Attaching snippet.
Eli (SRE): ```
[02:14:03] upsert.bulk size=120k items duration=78s
[02:14:46] kv-cache-miss flush triggered
[02:15:01] worker-3 OOMKilled, restarting
[02:15:02] 503 transient on /v1/generate
```
Sanjay (Support): We've throttled the customer's bursts as temporary mitigation. They still see timeouts on long prefix calls.
Michelle (CS): Ok. Proposed comms: 1) Acknowledge and immediate mitigation summary, 2) interim workaround (burst throttling + schedule change), 3) ETA for root cause & fix, 4) plan to prevent recurrence. I can own customer-facing note if we agree.
Julia (AE): Please include a credit offer tied to SLA for last 30 days if we don't meet the next check-in. They pushed back once already.
Eli (SRE): Root cause hypothesis: their private deployment has a small KV cache setting + aggressive GC when memory pressure spikes due to large batch imports. Two-pronged fix: increase KV cache size and add circuit-breaker for upserts to avoid OOM cascade. Config change safe to ship to their Private cluster?
Sanjay (Support): Ops-bot ran quick compatibility check — ops-bot: config-change-allowed True (no downtime anticipated).
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: change_allowed=true note="kv_cache_size bump + upsert-rate limiter OK for node pools"
Michelle (CS): Good. Timeline proposal: immediate customer note (today EOD), apply config bump & rate limiter in staging tomorrow, deploy to customer on Tuesday with monitoring. Who can run the change and own validation?
Eli (SRE): I can run the staging test tomorrow AM and validate with synthetic load. Need Julia to confirm a maintenance window with the customer for Tuesday.
Julia (AE): I can lock in Tuesday 09:00 their local time. I'll ask for permission to run the change and request logs post-change.
Sanjay (Support): I'll provide the exact mitigation steps and a short FAQ (what we changed, why, rollback steps).
Michelle (CS): I'll draft the customer EOD note — include: what happened, what we did (throttle + staging test), expected timeline, and the compensation offer. Tagging @Julia to confirm renewal talk messaging.
Julia (AE): Got it. I'll coordinate renewal messaging to avoid surprise credits being promised twice.
Eli (SRE): After deploy, I'll monitor p50/p95 and error rate; will post a short report in this thread within 4 hours of deployment.
Michelle (CS): Great — comms owner: Michelle. Technical owner: Eli. Support follow-up: Sanjay. AE lead: Julia. Next steps: Michelle to post draft by 17:00, SRE staging test tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
Sanjay (Support): adding quick checklist for the draft: short root-cause summary, immediate mitigation, timelines (staging/deploy), retention of logs for next 30 days, contact point (michelle@redwood).
Michelle (CS): Draft ready: "Hi Greenline team — thanks for flagging. We located batch-induced cache thrash causing transient errors; we’ve applied a temporary burst-throttle and scheduled a config change to increase KV cache + rate limiting. Staging validation tomorrow, planned deploy Tue 09:00 local. We'll follow up with metrics and a compensatory credit if SLA not met in next 30 days." Anyone object?
Julia (AE): Sounds good, please cc me.
Eli (SRE): No objections. Make sure to include that this will not require downtime.
Sanjay (Support): +1 and will forward the troubleshooting playbook if they ask for details.
Michelle (CS): Sending now. I'll paste the outbound note here once sent and then add the Tuesday follow-up plan.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled for 1732196276 to check deployment report.
